subject: Title alignment and offer approval — Candidate JZ-391
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@greenleaf.io>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Candidate JZ-391 — leveling recommendation and comp ask

Hi Soojin & Laura,

Quick context: John Zhao (JZ-391) completed the final loop for Backend ML Infra (reports to Elena Morales). Strong systems + model infra background, coming from a scale infra team at Hotelatech. Resume attached.

Hiring team preference is split: Elena prefers Principal IC (to lead architect work across teams); Elena also notes this hire will run a small project team in 12–18 months. Talent bench suggests L6 Eng Mgr could better fit roadmap ownership. We need a quick calibration on title (L6 Manager vs Principal IC) and signoff on offer numbers so we can move fast — John has other active conversations and expects an answer this week if possible.

Suggested bands (high-level):
- L6 Engineering Manager: base $215k–245k, bonus 15% target, equity 0.5% (4y)
- Principal IC (L6 Principal): base $240k–265k, bonus 20% target, equity 0.6% (4y)

Attachments: JZ391_resume.pdf, JZ391_compsheet.xlsx (comp comps and internal anchors).

Request: Can the group confirm title recommendation + maximum total cash we can offer without exec escalations? Also need HC approval/confirmation that headcount is available for Q4.

Thanks,
Priya
Greenleaf Analytics (recruiter)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@greenleaf.io>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate JZ-391 — leveling recommendation and comp ask

Thanks Priya — quick thoughts:

- Role needs a strong program/people tilt if we make them manager. We don't have a direct IC who can simultaneously own infra architecture and people growth for the roadmap items Elena outlined.
- If John prefers IC track, we should consider Principal IC and pair with a senior manager hire later. If the org wants faster people development in the stack, L6 Eng Mgr is preferable.
- For speed to close and retention, leaning Principal IC will cost more cash/equity but may reduce ramp risk; lean L6 Manager to conserve equity and because we have capacity on ICs to deliver now.

Can Marcus and Finance advise on whether the Principal IC band is fundable within the Q4 hiring cushion or if that needs exec signoff?

-Laura
VP, Engineering

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate JZ-391 — leveling recommendation and comp ask

Looping in finance guidance. Per the compsheet (attached) and current Q4 hiring cushion:

- Principal IC at target market comp for this profile would be total cash (base + expected bonus) in the range $290k–$330k and ~0.55%–0.75% eq.
- L6 Eng Manager would be total cash $250k–$280k and ~0.45%–0.6% eq.

We currently have ~1.2M in uncommitted hiring cushion for infra org in Q4 (across reqs WD-2026-4978 and WD-2026-4982). Approving Principal IC at upper quartile would consume ~25–30% of that cushion; it's doable but triggers exec review for any single offer >$320k total cash or >0.7% eq.

Recommendation: Approve an L6 Eng Manager baseline offer up to $275k total cash / 0.6% eq without exec escalation. If the hiring manager makes a strong case for Principal IC, we can escalate to Exec review; provide a short one-page business case (impact, cross-team dependencies, retention risk).

Marcus
Dir, Total Comp & Finance

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@greenleaf.io>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Candidate JZ-391 — leveling recommendation and comp ask

Thanks team. Based on the guidance:
- We will default to L6 Eng Manager for offer to keep within non-escalation path. Offer to extend: Base $220,000, target bonus 15% (on-target cash $253k), RSU grant ~0.55% (4y).
- If John counters for Principal IC comp, we'll pause and prepare exec case.

Action: Laura — can you confirm hiring manager is amenable to L6 Manager? Elena, can you confirm via reply by EOD 11/16? If we get a yes, I'll prepare the official offer packet and request HC approval form completion (attached: hc-approval-form-2026Q4.pdf).

I have the candidate on a soft timeline — he prefers a decision by Thursday 11/18.

Thanks,
Soojin
Sr. PM, Talent & Recruiting Operations
